--CETAS
-- CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE AS 


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'cetas_revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET_FORMAT
)
AS
SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

-- CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE

--EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
-- EXT FILE FORMAT
-- LOCATION

--DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.revenue_ext_table;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(4000),
    Revenue VARCHAR(4000)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = CSV_FORMAT

);

select * from dbo.revenue_ext_table;

SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;


SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/titanic.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS QUERY2;

CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD ='password';

-- CREATE CREDENTIAL

CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL SynapseCreds
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';

-- EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://sasynapsedemo.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL = SynapseCreds
);

--https://sasynapsedemo.blob.core.windows.net/raw

--OPENROWSET FUNCTION

SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

--DROP EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'cetas_revenue/',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = PARQUET_FORMAT
)
AS
SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

SELECT * FROM revenue_cetas;

    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE

SELECT * FROM REVENUE_VIEW;
